query: What algorithm picks which shared buffer to evict when a new page needs to be read into the buffer pool?

matches.reason: Implements the clock-hand advancement primitive that cycles through NBuffers, the core mechanic of the clock-sweep eviction algorithm.

The authoritative function that selects an evictable shared buffer by repeatedly ticking the clock hand and decrementing usage counts until an unpinned, zero-usage-count buffer is pinned as the victim.
